pages.text: $(thing)Mowzie's Mobs$() adds animated creatures and four bosses, each tied to a structure, with masks, weapons and armor you can wear.

Structures: the $(bold)Wrought Chamber$() (Ferrous Wroughtnaut, an armored iron golem), the $(bold)Umvuthana Grove$() and $(bold)Monastery$() (Umvuthi, the Sunbird, and his tribe), and the Frostmaw's spawns in snowy places. Tongbi, the Sculptor, is the fourth boss.

pages.title: Sol Visage
pages.text: Umvuthi's mask. The Umvuthana masks (Fury, Fear, Rage, Bliss, Misery, Faith) are worn for abilities.

pages.title: Earthrend Gauntlet
pages.text: The Sculptor's gauntlet. The Geomancer set (staff, robe, beads) is his too.
Smaller mobs: Foliaath, Lantern, Grottol (a mineral creature), Bluff, Naga and Elokosa. Frostmaw's Ice Crystal is a weapon. Bosses: $(l:exploration/bosses)Bosses$(/l).
